findings.title: Brand-mark contrast still ~2:1 (tracked)
findings.detail: .brand-mark 'J' remains saffron-700 (rgb 154,74,18) on the indigo gradient, about 1.9-2.2:1 on every view. Accepted interim state from IR1-3; proposal §16 now assigns it to the increment 2 Sidebar rebuild.
findings.action: Increment 2 Sidebar rebuild must use an allowlisted §3.2 pair; confirm in the increment 2 review.

findings.title: Pre-existing horizontal overflow at 390 and 768 (tracked)
findings.detail: Independently re-measured against visualViewport.width: 390 Dashboard 609px, Access matrix 766px; 768 My feed and Notices & feedback 849px, Access matrix 996px; none at 1280/1536. All from baseline CSS (.reward-card, .access-matrix-*, .hanuman-mini-list).
findings.action: Fix in 4a (Dashboard, My feed), 4c (Notices & feedback) and 4d (Access matrix at both widths) as recorded in §16; AC-9.1 cannot pass until then.

findings.title: Cascade gate covers 2 of 4 widths and no Dialog behaviour
findings.detail: primitive-cascade.mjs runs at 1280 and 390 only and checks static computed styles; Dialog focus trap, Escape, return focus and toast.dismiss() on first open remain browser-untested.
findings.action: When promoting to scripts/ui-audit/ in increment 2, run at 768 and 1536 too and extend it to Dialog focus trap, Escape, return focus, toast dismiss and 16px fields inside a dialog at 390.

findings.title: Layered base loses to unlayered legacy rules in later ports
findings.detail: With base.css in layer(base), any unlayered legacy rule beats the global :focus-visible outline and .jb-sacred font regardless of specificity. No change today (style-snap shows identical focus outlines on 50 surfaces), but ported surfaces relying on these will lose to leftover legacy selectors (e.g. ribbon font-family).
findings.action: When porting each surface, delete its legacy rules from index.css rather than layering new ones on top; keep style-snap's focus-outline capture in the per-increment gate.
